value.rationale: This resolves a natural geometry-driven sampling tradeoff between worst-boundary local coverage (Hausdorff) and aggregate area error. It proves a complete structural and computationally effective law for every smooth positively curved plane body, a noncircle strict price, an active clipped region, and a unique equal-error minimax law. The sup-versus-integral objective is distinct from previously treated two-integral area/perimeter sampling. Beyond a routine check it produces a genuinely different optimal density class.
